activity-recovery-control-failed: Akukhonakalanga kucinisekisa silungiselelo sekulethwa. Vuselela bese ubuketa simo saso salamuhla.
activity-recovery-denied: Kufinyelela kwalowemukelako noma tintfo latitsandzako tetatiso akusakuvumeli kulethwa.
activity-recovery-description: Tatiso letingakapheli tiphindvwa ngekutenta. Buketa imisebenti lengekho noma leshintjile ngaphambi kwekuphindza. Kuphindza akusoze kwakha kabusha umsebenti.
activity-recovery-failed: Akukhonakalanga kucedza kulethwa kwetatiso. Umsebenti lolindzile ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenti wekucala awukho noma ushintjile. Kute lokwakhiwe kabusha.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hlunga tinsuku temakhadi usebentisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt nobe @listEnteredAt. Sibonelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' nobe @endAt = none. Faka ligama lendzawo leyentiwe ngekwakho lelicala nga-@ emkhatsini wetimphawu tekucaphuna.
advanced-filter-description: Sihlungi Lesitfutfukile sivumela kubhala luchungechunge lolunalaba basebenti: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sikhala sisetjentiswa njengesehlukanisi emkhatsini Webasebenti. Ungahluza tonkhe Tindzawo Letikhetsekile ngekubhala emagama nemagugu ato. Sibonelo: Field1 == Value1. Caphela: Uma tindzawo noma emagugu anetikhala, kufanele uwavale ngemacaphuno lamancane. Sibonelo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kuze wece tinhlavu tekulawula letisodvwa (' /), ungasebentisa \. Sibonelo: Field1 == I\'m. Ungahlanganisa nemibandzela leminyenti. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngalokuvamile bonkhe basebenti bahunyushwa kusuka ngesancele kuya ngesekudla. Ungashintja kuhleleka ngekufaka tibiyelo. Sibonelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ungaphindze useshe tindzawo tembhalo nge-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
autoAddUsersWithDomainName: Engeta ngekutentakalela basebentisi labaneligama lalendzawo ye-inthanethi
avatars-upload-blocked-description: Vimbela basebentisi ekulayisheni titfombe temsebentisi letisha (kulungele uma titfombe tivumelaniswa kulomunye umtfombo). Titfombe temsebentisi tivuliwe ngekwemisiwe.

blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_4: Uma linani lekucala liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekucala lemiyalo. Ngalokunye, uma linani lesibili liliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lesibili lemiyalo. Uma kute ematfuba laliciniso, yenta libhulokhi lekugcina lemiyalo.

blockly-LOGIC_TERNARY_TOOLTIP: Hlola simo ku-'hlola'. Nangabe simo siliciniso, ibuyisa linani le-'uma kuliciniso'; ngalokunye ibuyisa linani le-'uma kungemanga'.

blockly-MATH_ATAN2_TOOLTIP: Buyisa i-arctangent yelicophelo (X, Y) ngemadigri kusuka ku -180 kuya ku-180.
blockly-MATH_CONSTANT_TOOLTIP: Buyisa linye lemanani lajwayelekile langaguculuki: π (3.141…), e (2.718…), φ (1.618…), sqrt(2) (1.414…), sqrt(½) (0.707…), noma ∞ (lokungapheli).

blockly-MATH_IS_TOOLTIP: Hlola nangabe inombolo ilingene, ayilingani, iyinhloko, iphelele, ingenhla kwa-0, ingentansi kwa-0, noma nangabe iyehlukaniseka ngenombolo letsite. Ibuyisa liciniso noma emanga.

blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MODE: Buyisa luhlu lwetintfo letivela kakhulu eluhlwini.

blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Secwayiso: Lelibhulokhi lingasetjentiswa ngekhatsi kwencazelo yesento kuphela.

blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Engeta, susa, noma uhlele kabusha tigaba kute uhlele kabusha lelibhulokhi lembhalo.

blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: tfola incenye yembhalo kusuka eluhlamvini # kusuka ekugcineni

blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa liciniso nangabe umbhalo lonikiwe ungenalutfo.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Yakha incenye yembhalo ngekuhlanganisa nanoma ngutiphi tintfo.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Ibuyisa linani letinhlamvu (kufaka netikhala) embhalweni lonikiwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Phrinta umbhalo loshiwo, inombolo noma lelinye linani.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Shintjanisa konkhe kuvela kwembhalo lotsite ngekhatsi kwalomunye umbhalo.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Buyisa likhophi lembhalo lesusiwe tikhala kulolunye noma kuto tombili tinhlangotsi.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Lokuguculukako lokubitwa ngekutsi '%1' sekuvele kukhona ngalolunye luhlobo: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Lokuguculukako lokubitwa ngekutsi '%1' sekuvele kukhona njengepharamitha esentweni '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Sesha indzawo yekusebentela. Cindzetela Enter kute utfole lokufananako lokulandzelako, Shift+Enter kute utfole langaphambili. Cindzetela Escape kuvala kusesha bese ugcila kulokufananako kwamanje.
board-status-remaining-time-total: Sikhatsi lesisele kuze kube ngusuku lekugcina
bots-none: Akukabi nemabhothi. Libhothi lisebenti eseva yakho - lomenteli we-AI, umsebenti we-CI, iskripthi - lolibhodi leliniketa emakhadi.
card-archive-pop: Likhadi angeke libonakale kuloluhlu ngemuva kwekuliyisa Engobolweni.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: I Cloud Panel ngeye SuperAdmin kuphela, ku domain ye Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Nge WeKan ku Weddy, i Cloud Panel isebentela ema domain lamanyenti e WeKan kusuka ku server yinye, ngayinye inemininingwane yayo. Ku domain ye Cloud Panel, i SuperAdmin iphatsa ema domain ne CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Nge sikhiya se CloudFlare API, i domain lene zone yayo ise-akhawunti yakho ye CloudFlare itfola irekhodi le DNS lele proxy kanye nesitifiketi se CloudFlare Origin. Letinye ema domain titfola sitifiketi se Let's Encrypt. Sikhiya sigcinwa ku server futsi angeke siphindze siveteke.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Akukho sikhiya se CloudFlare API lesigciniwe: yonkhe i domain itfola sitifiketi se Let's Encrypt.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Letinye tinsika letingeniswa njengetindzawo letikhetsekile tembhalo:
csv-mapping-description: Khetsa insika yelifayela lephetse indzawo ngayinye yelikhadi. Kukhetsa kwentiwe ngekwemabito etinsika; shintja lokungalungi, bese ukhetsa (akukho kulifayela) endzaweni lelifayela lingenayo.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Lifayela alinayo insika yeluhlu. Khetsa leyinye ngenhla, noma bhala libito leluhlu lunye lapho onkhe emakhadi aya khona.
csv-mapping-list-required: Bhala libito leluhlu lapho onkhe emakhadi aya khona, noma khetsa insika lephetse luhlu.
delete-all-notifications-confirm: Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kususa tonkhe tatiso? Lesento asikwati kubuyiselwa emuva.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kulethwa akukhonanga kucinisekiswa; buketa ngaphambi kwekuphindza
email-invite-register-text:
Sawubona __user__,

__inviter__ ukumema kutsi ujoyine libhodi le-kanban kuze nibambisane.

Uyacelwa ulandzele sichumanisi lesingentasi:
__url__

Ikhodi yakho yesimemo ngu: __icode__

Siyabonga.
email-recovery-busy: Kutfumela nobe lomunye umsebenti weluhlu uyachubeka. Vuselela bese utama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela yonkhe imilayeto leseluhlwini nyalo yalomemukeli? Lokucuketfwe kuyo kutawususwa futsi ngeke kubuyiselwe. Imilayeto lemisha leyentiwe ngemuva kwalesicelo itawugcinwa.
email-recovery-description: Umugca munye wememukeli ngamunye. Sesha nge-ID yemsebentisi. Lokucuketfwe ngumlayeto netinkhundla te-imeyili tememukeli akukhonjiswa. Kumisa kwesikhashana kubamba imilayeto lekhona naletako; Kuchubeka kutama futsi kutfumela imilayeto leseluhlwini nyalo. Kukhansela kususa imilayeto lefakwe eluhlwini kuze kube sikhatsi sesicelo. Nangabe kutfumela kumatasa, tama futsi ngemuva kwesikhashana. Umlayeto losewucalile kutfunyelwa awukwati kubuyiswa, futsi kutfumela lokunemphumela longacinisekile kungaphindvwa. Kwehluleka lokungapheli nemilayeto lefinyelele emkhawulweni wekutama futsi kusala kute kuhlolwe. Kutama futsi imilayeto leyehlulekile kucala umjikeleto lomusha wemetamo futsi kugcina kumiswa kwesikhashana lokukhona.
email-recovery-empty: Ayikho imilayeto eluhlwini futsi abekho bemukeli labamiselwe kutfumela kwesikhashana.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenti awukwazanga kucinisekiswa. Vuselela luhlu bese utama futsi sento lesifanako nangabe kudzingeka.
email-recovery-superseded: Sento lesisha semsebentisi lophetse sitsatse indzawo yalesicelo. Kukhonjiswa simo sanyalo seluhlu.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwati kufundvwa luhlu lwema-imeyili. Hlola emalungelo emphatsi nekutfolakala kweseva.
email-resetPassword-text:

Kuze usethe kabusha iphasiwedi yakho, mane uchafate sichumanisi lesingentasi.

__url__

Siyabonga.
email-verifyEmail-text:
Sawubona __user__,

Kuze ucinisekise i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho, mane uchafate sichumanisi lesingentasi.

__url__

Siyabonga.
error-json-schema: Idatha yakho ye-JSON ayinalo lwati lolufanele ngefomethi lefanele
filter-on-desc: Uhlunga emakhadi kulelibhodi. Chafata lapha kuze uhlele sihlungi.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kwemisebenti ye-Asana ({ "data": [...] } kusuka ekutfumeleni kwe-Asana noma GET /tasks). Imisebenti ihlelwa ngetigaba (memberships); imisebenti lecedziwe iya ku-Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ku-Businessmap (lebekade iyi-Kanbanize), vula Advanced Search, khetsa Configure results kute ukhetse tinsika, landa lifayela le-Excel, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Tinsika tifundvwa ngemabito ato esiNgisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): uma i-akhawunti yakho isebentisa lolunye lulwimi, cala ushintje libito lemugca wetihloko libe ngesiNgisi. I-Column iba luhlu kantsi i-Lane iba yimizila; banikati, ematheg, umbala, emalanga, imibono netihlanganisi letingumtali kugcina tindzawo tako, kantsi Priority, Size, Type naletinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ku-ClickUp, tfumela imisebenti njenge-CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noma kutfumela kwekubuka kwe-List noma Table kanye nato tonkhe tinsika), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, luhlu lwe-ClickUp luba yimizila, kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi kanye nemisebenti lemincane, labanikwe umsebenti, ematheg, emalanga, kubaluleka nesikhatsi.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namatsisela Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngakhoma (CSV)/Emagugu Lahlukaniswe Ngemathebhu (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Namatsisela i-JSON yelibhodi le-NextCloud Deck (libhodi leline-"stacks", sitaki ngasinye siphetse ema-"cards" aso). Titaki tiba tinhlu nemakhadi aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetsa liphepha le-.xlsx lesitayela se-WeKan (emakholomu lafananako nekutfunyelwa kwe-Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Umugca wekucala uyinhloko.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Khipha lifayela le-.boardarchive endzaweni lecindzetelwe bese unamatselisa lokuse-board.jsonl yebhodi, nemugca wenguqulo noma ngaphandle kwawo. Sici sekuhlanganisa ngemacembu ekubukweni kwebhodi siba tinhla, letinye tici tekukhetsa tibe emalebula, emabhulokhi embhalo nemabhokisi ekumaka abe inchazelo neluhla lwekuhlola, bese imibono iyagcinwa. Titfombe netinamatsiselo atingeniswa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namatsisela luhlu lwe-JSON lwetinkinga te-__sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Tinkinga tiba emakhadi lahlelwe etinhleni Letivulekile / Letivaliwe.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namatsisela i-JSON letfunyelwe yi-Kanboard: intfo lena-"columns" (noma imisebenti lena-column_name) kanye neluhlu lwe-"tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Emakholomu aba tinhlu nemisebenti iba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ku-Kanri, vula Import & Export bese ukhetsa Export individual board (noma Export all data), bese unamatsisela lifayela le-.json. Tinsika tiba luhlu kantsi emakhadi aba ngemakhadi, kanye nenchazelo yawo, lusuku lwekuphela, ematheg nemibala; imisebenti yelikhadi iba luhlu lwekuhlola. Ekutfumeleni yonkhe idatha kungeniswa libhodi lekucala.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namatsisela sakhiwo se-Leo (lifayela le-.leo). Tincenye letisezingeni lelisetulu tiba tinhla, tincenye letingaphansi kwato ngalokucondzile tiba ngemakhadi, bese umbhalo wencenye uba yinchazelo yelikhadi. Tincenye letisemazingeni lajulile tiba tinhla tekuhlola. Tincenye letiphawuliwe tingeniswa njengaleticedziwe.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ku-Linear, tfumela tinkinga njenge-CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noma kutfumela kwekubuka), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, emacembu aba yimizila, kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi kanye nalonikwe umsebenti, emalebula, emalanga, inkinga lengumtali, kubaluleka, kulinganisa, iphrojekthi nesiyingi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela luhlu lwemisebenti lwe-markdown (indlela lesetjentiswa ngemathulusi ye-markdown-kanban afana ne-Obsidian Kanban): tinhloko "## Ligama lwelluhlu", netintfo "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ngentasi. Tinhloko tiba luhlu naletintfo tibe emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ku-MeisterTask, chafata libito lephrojekthi, khetsa Export project bese utfumela i-CSV, bese uyanamatsisela. Tigaba tiba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba emakhadi, kanye nemanotsi ayo, lusuku lwekuphela, lonikwe umsebenti nematheg; imisebenti lephelile igcina lusuku lwayo lwekuphela. I-CSV lebhalelwe kungenisa kwa-MeisterTask nayo iyasebenta.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ku-monday.com, vula imenyu yelibhodi, khetsa More actions na-Export board to Excel (kanye netibuyekezo netintfo letincane uma ufuna), bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Insika ye-Status iba luhlu kantsi emacembu aba yimizila; bantfu, emalanga, umugca wesikhatsi nematheg kugcina tindzawo tako, letinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile kantsi tibuyekezo tiba yimibono.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ku-Notion, vula i-database njengelikhasi lonkhe, khetsa ••• na-Export, khetsa Markdown & CSV, bese ukhetsa lifayela le-.zip lelilandwako, noma i-CSV yinye ye-database leyiphuma kulo, noma unamatsisele leyo CSV. Insika lebitwa ngekutsi Status iba luhlu (uma ingekho, insika yekucala lebukeka njengekukhetsa iba yiyo, kantsi umbiko wekungenisa usho kutsi nguyiphi); imigca iba ngemakhadi kanye nesihloko sawo, ematheg njengemalebula, bantfu njengemalunga, emalanga, kanye nembhalo welikhasi njengenchazelo; letinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Kuhlobana, titfombe nalokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ku-Nullboard, vula libhodi, khetsa Export this board... kumenyu, vula lifayela le-.nbx kusihleli sembhalo bese unamatsisela lokukulo. Luhlu luba luhlu kantsi emanotsi aba ngemakhadi: umugca wekucala welinotsi usihloko selikhadi kantsi lokusele kuyinchazelo yalo. Linotsi lelingakalungiswa litfola ilebula raw. Lifayela lelinemabhodi lamanyenti lingenisa libhodi lalo lekucala.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ku-Obsidian, vula lifayela lelibhodi le-Kanban njenge-Markdown (noma vula lifayela le-.md kusihleli sembhalo), bese unamatsisela konkhe. Imizila iba luhlu kanye nemikhawulo yemakhadi, emakhadi agcina ematheg, emalanga, kubaluleka, tindzawo neluhlu lwekuhlola, kantsi i-Archive iba ngemakhadi laseNgobolweni.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namatsisela i-JSON yelicembu lemaphakheji emsebenti we-OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Timo tiba tinhlu nemaphakheji emsebenti aba emakhadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namatsisela luhlaka lwe-OPML, njengobe Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq nalabanye bakutfumela. Tintfo tesigaba sekucala tiba luhlu, bantfwana bato baba emakhadi lanelinothi njengenchazelo, kantsi tintfo letijulile tiba luhlu lwekuhlola. Tintfo letiphelile tingena njengaletiphelile.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namatsisela lifayela le-Org mode, njengobe Emacs, Orgzly noma Beorg ilibhala. Tihloko tesigaba sekucala tiba luhlu kantsi tihloko tesigaba sesibili tiba emakhadi. TODO na-DONE, kubaluleka, ematheg, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na-CLOSED kuyagcinwa, kantsi emabhokisi ekuhlola netihloko letijulile kuba luhlu lwekuhlola.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ku-Pivotal Tracker, vula ithebhu ye-MORE yephrojekthi bese ukhetsa Export CSV (noma khetsa tindzaba bese ukhetsa Bulk Actions, CSV), bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Simo ngasinye sendzaba siba luhlu kantsi tindzaba tiba ngemakhadi, kanye nelUhlobo lwato nemalebula, banikati, locelako, emalanga, imibono, imisebenti netivimbeli; Estimate iba ngemaphoyinti endzaba kantsi tikhatsi tiba ngema-sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ku-Plane, vula Workspace Settings, khetsa Exports, tfumela ema-phrojekthi njenge-JSON, CSV noma Excel bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela, noma lifayela linye lelingekhatsi kwalo, noma unamatsisele i-JSON noma i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu, ema-phrojekthi aba yimizila, kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi kanye nesihlonzi sato, umtali, labanikwe umsebenti, emalebula, emalanga, tihlanganisi nemibono; kubaluleka, kulinganisa, siyingi nemojuli kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Kutfumela kwa-Plane akunato tinchazelo noma lokunamatselwe, ngako akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ku-Quire, vula imenyu yephrojekthi bese ukhetsa Export CSV, bese unamatsisela i-CSV. Timo tiba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemisebenti lemincane njengemakhadi labantfwana, labanikwe umsebenti, ematheg njengemalebula, emalanga ekucala, ekuphela nalocedziwe, inchazelo nekubaluleka njengendzawo lekhetsekile. Imibono nalokunamatselwe akukho ku-CSV ya-Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ku-Redmine, vula ema-Issues ephrojekthi, khetsa Also available in: CSV ngentansi yeluhlu, khetsa tinsika (All columns, kanye ne-Description) bese uyatfumela, bese unamatsisela i-CSV. I-Redmine itsa tinsika ngelulwimi lwakho, ngako setha lulwimi lwakho lube sisiNgisi ku-My account ngaphambi kwekutfumela. Simo ngasinye siba luhlu kantsi tinkinga tiba ngemakhadi, kanye ne-tracker njengelebula, lonikwe umsebenti, umbhali, emalanga, umsebenti lomtali netinkinga letihlobene; kubaluleka, sigaba, inguculo lehlosiwe, sikhatsi lesilinganisiwe, % Done netindzawo letikhetsekile kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ku-Super Productivity, vula Settings, bese kuba Sync & Backup, khetsa Export Data bese unamatsisela lokukulifayela le-sp-backup .json. Iphrojekthi ngayinye iba ngumzila kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi ku-To Do, In Progress, Backlog noma Done, kanye nemanotsi ayo, ematheg, lusuku lwekuphela, sikhatsi lesisetjentisiwe nemisebenti lemincane; imisebenti leseNgobolweni iba ngemakhadi laseNgobolweni.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ku-Taiga, vula Admin > Project > Export bese ulanda ikhophi yephrojekthi (vula kuqala lifayela le-.json.gz), bese unamatsisela i-JSON yalo. Timo tetindzaba temsebentisi tiba luhlu, tindzaba temsebentisi tiba ngemakhadi kanye nemisebenti yato njengemisebenti lemincane, ema-epic netinkinga kutfola imizila yako, kantsi ema-sprint, ematheg, imibono netimfanelo letikhetsekile kuyeta. Lokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ku-Tasks.org, vula Settings, Backups bese ukhetsa Export tasks, bese unamatsisela lokukulelo lifayela le-.json. Luhlu luba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemanotsi ayo, ematheg, emalanga, imibono nemisebenti lemincane; imisebenti lephelile igcina lusuku lwayo lwekuphela, kantsi kubaluleka kuba yindzawo lekhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namatselisa umphumela we-task export: luhla lwe-JSON noma umsebenti munye emgceni ngamunye. Imisebenti lephelile iya ku-Done, project ne-priority kuba emalebula, annotations iba imibono, kantsi depends iba kwetsemba imisebenti levimbako.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ku-Teamwork.com, gcwalisa sibonelo sekungenisa imisebenti se-Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) bese usigcina njenge-.xlsx, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela. Luhlu lwemisebenti luba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi; umsebenti locala nga -, # noma > uba ngumsebenti lomncane wemsebenti longenhla kwawo (--, ## noma >> sigaba sinye lesijulile). Labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga nematheg kugcina tindzawo tako; Priority, Estimated time na-Complete kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ku-TickTick, vula Settings, Account, Backup & Import bese wenta likhophi lekulondoloza, bese unamatsisela lifayela le-CSV. Luhlu ngalunye lwe-TickTick luba ngumzila kantsi tinsika talo tiba luhlu; imisebenti igcina ematheg, emalanga, luhlu lwekuhlola, kubaluleka nemisebenti lemincane.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namatselisa lifayela le-todo.txt: umsebenti munye emgceni ngamunye, ngendlela luhlelo lwe-todo.txt netinhlelo letihambisanako letibhala ngayo. Imisebenti lephelile ("x") iya kulokuphelile, +project na-@context kuba ngemalebula, (A) iba lilebula lekubaluleka, kantsi due: na-t: kuba tinsuku tekugcina netekucala.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ku-Vikunja, vula Settings, khetsa Data Export bese ulanda lifayela le-.zip lelikutfumelako, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela, noma unamatsisele i-data.json lengekhatsi kwalo. Emabhakede e-Kanban aba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye nemalebula, labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga, inchazelo, luhlu lwemisebenti njengeluhlu lwekuhlola nemibono; kubaluleka, liphesenti lelentiwe na-done kuba tindzawo letikhetsekile. Lokunamatselwe akungeniswa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ku-Wrike, tfumela iphrojekthi noma lifolda ku-Excel, noma gcwalisa sibonelo sekungenisa se-Excel sa-Wrike, bese ukhetsa lelo lifayela le-.xlsx. Imigca yelifolda neyephrojekthi iba yimizila, i-Status iba luhlu kantsi imisebenti iba ngemakhadi, kanye ne-Key yayo, umsebenti lomtali, labanikwe umsebenti, emalanga ekucala nekuphela, kuncikana nenchazelo; Priority, Duration naletinye tinsika tiba tindzawo letikhetsekile.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namatsisela i-JSON yekutfunyelwa kweluhlu lwe-ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Tigaba tiba tinhlu netintfo tiba emakhadi.
import-file-label: Khetsa lifayela lekutfumela, noma unamatsisele umbhalo walo ngentansi:
import-members-map: Libhodi lakho lelingenisiwe linemalunga. Uyacelwa umatanise emalunga lofuna kuwangenisa nebasebentisi bakho
import-members-map-note: Caphela: Emalunga langakamataniswa atawubelwa kumsebentisi wamanje.
import-members-mode-map: Khetsa umsebentisi lokhona kulowo nalowo wabo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagcine njengebasebentisi bendzawo ngemabito abo, kute ubahlanganise nebasebentisi bangempela ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi
import-report-description: Libhodi lakhiwe, kodvwa letinye tincenye telifayela atikakwati kudluliselwa. Umbiko lofanako ugcinwe ku-Iphaneli yemlawuli → Tinkinga → Kubuyisela.
import-too-large: Lifayela likhulu kakhulu kutsi lingeniswe kanye kanye. Lehlukanise libe ngemafayela lamancane, sibonelo ngeliphrojekthi noma ngelilanga, bese ungenisa ngalinye.
instance-desc: Wonkhe umsebentisi longenile kule WeKan angalibona lelibhodi. Alikhonjiswa nanini kubantfu labangangeni. Bantfu labengetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalihlela.
list-permissions-desc: Loko indzima ngayinye lengakwenta kulolu luhla, ngetulu kwaloko lokuvunyelwa ngulibhodi. Baphatsi belibhodi bangahlela njalo.
name: Ligama
notification-delivery-layout-clear: Kuhlelwe kahle: libhodi, ngubani, likhadi ngemabhalo lagcamile
private-desc: Lelibhodi lingasese. Bantfu labangetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalibuka baphindze balihlele.
public-desc: Lelibhodi lisesidlangalaleni. Libonakala kunoma ngubani lonesichumanisi futsi litawubonakala kutinjini tekusesha njenge-Google. Bantfu labangetwe ebhodini kuphela labangalihlela.
r-blocks-conflict: Lomtsetfo ushintjile ngesikhatsi usahlela. Layisha kabusha umtsetfo logciniwe ngaphambi kwekugcina.
r-blocks-help: Hlanganisa sicalisi sinye nesento sinye. Hudvula emabhulokhi ebhokisini lemathulusi. Sebentisa sihleli selifomu kutfola letinye tindlela letetfukile.
r-blocks-invalid: Hlanganisa sicalisi sinye kuphela nesento sinye. Susa emabhulokhi langakahlanganiswa noma lengetiwe ngaphambi kwekugcina.
r-blocks-permission: Imvume yemphatsi welibhodi iyadzingeka kute uhlele imitsetfo.
r-blocks-unavailable: Idatha yemtsetfo ayitfolakali. Sebentisa sihleli selifomu kubuketa lomtsetfo.
r-cron-invalid: Luhlelo lwesikhatsi lwe-cron lunetindzawo letisihlanu: umzuzu lihora lilanga inyanga lilanga leliviki.
r-email-members-hint: Lilunga lelibhodi lelengetwe ohlwini liya ku-Ku njenge-@username bese litfunyelwa kulikheli le-imeyili lalo. Lamanye emakheli e-imeyili asengabhalwa ku-Ku.
r-import-paste: Namatsisela imitsetfo letfunyelwe ngaphandle (JSON noma CSV) noma imiyalo ye-Trello Butler lapha
r-import-trello: Ngenisa imitsetfo kusuka ku-Trello Butler (ngemandla onkhe)
r-import-trello-note: Lokutfunyelwa kwemabhodi e-Trello akukacukatsi imitsetfo ye-Butler. Namatsisela umbhalo wemiyalo ye-Butler lapha kuze umatanise incenye lesekelwako; imigca lengakamataniswa iyabikwa.
r-import-workflow-note: Ngenisa kuhamba kwemsebenti lokubonakalako lokutfunyelwe kusuka ku-n8n noma Node-RED. Emanodi eticupho/tento latiwako amataniswa nemitsetfo ye-WeKan; emanodi langakamataniswa ayabikwa.
r-import-wrike-workflow-done: Indlela yemsebenti ya-Wrike "__name__": luhlu lu-__lists__ nemitsetfo le-__rules__ kungetiwe, tincenye leti-__skipped__ atifundvwanga
r-insert-variable: Faka lokugucukako endzaweni yembhalo loyikhetse kwekugcina:
r-rules-not-shown: Baphatsi belibhodi kuphela labangabona Imitsetfo yalelibhodi.
r-trigger-vars-hint: Tinkhaba teluhla, indlela, sihloko, luhla lwekuhlola nemsebentisi temukela ne-{creator}, {assignees}, {members} kanye ne-{customField:Name}. Emanani ato afundvwa ekhadini nakuhlolwa umtsetfo.
r-vars-people-hint: Futsi: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (emagama ebasebentisi embhalweni, emakheli e-imeyili enkhabeni yemamukeli) kanye ne-{customField:Field name}. Loku kuyasebenta nasemagameni emalunga, tinhluhla netindlela taletinye tento.
r-when-a-card-title-or-description-conta: Nangabe sihloko nobe incazelo yelikhadi inayo
r-workflow-help: Hudvula sicupho nesento ukufake kumakhi, bese wengeta umtsetfo. Hudvula sento usifake emtsetfweni lokhona kuze ushintje lokwentako.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Indlela yemsebenti ya-Wrike luhlu lwetimo, ngasinye seliqenjini le-Active, Completed, Deferred noma Cancelled. Kutfumela kubhala luhlu lwalelibhodi njengayinye, leletsa libito lelibhodi, nge-JSON lebuyiswa yi-API ya-Wrike yetindlela temsebenti: yakha leyo ndlela yemsebenti ku-Wrike ngaphambi kwekungenisa kutfumela kwe-Excel ya-Wrike kwalelibhodi, kute timo tayo tisebente. Kungenisa kufundza leyo JSON lenamatsiselwe ngenhla, levela ku-WeKan noma ku-GET /workflows ya-Wrike, kulibhodi lelikhetsiwe: simo lesingenaluhlu siba luhlu, kantsi umtsetfo ubeka likhadi njengeliphelile nangabe lisiwa esimeni lesi-Completed noma Cancelled kantsi alikapheli esimeni lesi-Active noma Deferred. Imitsetfo yekusebenta ngekwako ya-Wrike angeke itfunyelwe ivela ku-Wrike.
recovery-no-events: Kute tehlakalo tekubuyisela letirekhodiwe. Silulu siphilile.
recovery-report-desc: Tento tekuphepha kwedatha nekulungisa letentakalelako: kutfola konakala, tilondvoloti tembhalo, kubuyisela, kufudvuka kabusha kusuka ku-MongoDB, nekulungisa ngekutentakalela silulu lesikhukhumukile.
text-contains-trigger-description: Ihambisana nabe lidalwa likhadi, nobe sihloko sayo nobe incazelo yayo yishintjwe, futsi umbhalo lomusha unalokhu (akukho mehluko emkhatsini wemagama lamakhulu nalamancane).
title: Sihloko
tracking-info: Utawatiswa nganoma nguluphi lushintjo kulawo makhadi lohlanganyela kuwo njengemdali noma lilunga.
webhook-payload-description: Loko lokutfunyelwa ngema-webhook laphumako (Rocket.Chat, Slack, ...). Lokumisiwe kugcina silungiselelo lesitfolwe njengelifa; nangabe kute lokusetiwe, ema-webhook atfumela loko lebekasolo atfumela kona.
webhook-payload-field-people: Lilunga noma lonikwe umsebenti lokukhulunywa ngaye
